name: Clyde Estuary
note: Scottish estuary. Bed levels are ASSUMPTIONS (mAOD), no check gauges. Tide from Millport, 24.0 km from the end of the modelled reach (a stand-in gauge). River flow from SEPA (open data). No open national flood-defence dataset is available for Scotland, so defences are only those in the terrain. Tidal limit position is approximate.
